title: Treatment of Kidney Stones
item_service_description: <p> Traditional approaches for the treatment of kidney stones are the surgical technique nephrectomy (or nephrotomy) and endoscopic treatments via the urethra. In the last few years, several new approaches in the surgical management of upper urinary tract kidney stones have been developed, among them invasive and non-invasive lithotripsy techniques.</p>
revision_history: <p> 01/1988 - Covered transurethral ureteroscopic lithotripsy for the treatment of urinary tract stones of kidney or ureter. Effective date 01/16/1988. (TN 21)</p>
